## Handover notes

- `a21-cluster-ops--addon-upgrade-matrix`: `to_agent` A22 (A12 and A14 read the same plan). `goal` (upgrade the add-ons in the stated order), `completed`, `decisions` (order and `upgrade_at` per add-on), `artifacts` (matrix, digest, producer A21), `open_questions` (ranges without a source), `blockers` (blocked add-ons). Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a21-cluster-ops--autoscaler-tuning`: `to_agent` A20 (A25 reads the same report). `goal` (apply or reject the recommended bounds), `completed`, `decisions` (each bound with its source tool value), `artifacts` (audit file, digest, producer A21), `open_questions`, `verification`. Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a21-cluster-ops--capacity-forecast`: `to_agent` A25 (A20 and A23 consume the same `cluster.capacity.report`). `goal` (check the resilience impact of the forecast ceilings), `completed`, `decisions` (scenarios run and their factors), `artifacts` (report, digest, producer A21), `open_questions` (unsupplied growth, usage data), `verification` (`partial` when a dimension was skipped). Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a21-cluster-ops--cert-rotation-plan`: `to_agent` A14 (A12 and A22 read the same plan). `goal` (rotate the certificates in the stated order within the window), `completed`, `decisions` (buckets, node order, window), `artifacts` (plan, digest, producer A21), `blockers` (`human-approval`, quorum guard), `constraints` (one control-plane node at a time). Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a21-cluster-ops--cluster-bootstrap-baseline`: `to_agent` A24 (policy baseline next; A13 reads the status). `goal` (apply the policy baseline to the new cluster), `completed`, `decisions`, `artifacts` (verdict file, digest, producer A21), `blockers`, `open_questions`, `constraints` (production pending approval). Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.

Fill `goal` (approve and run the upgrade), `completed`, `decisions` (hops, pool order, window), `artifacts` (plan file, digest, producer A21), `open_questions`, `verification` (`partial` until every cross-check agreed). - `a21-cluster-ops--deprecated-api-remediation`: `to_agent` A22. `goal` (migrate the listed manifests before the upgrade), `completed` (counts, coverage), `decisions` (blockers vs minors), `artifacts` (report file, digest, producer A21), `open_questions` (skipped YAML, truncated scan), `verification` (`partial` when coverage is incomplete). Call `shared_handover_validate`, then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a21-cluster-ops--drain-and-cordon-plan`: `to_agent` A22 (owner of the PDBs and workloads; A12 and A14 read the plan). `goal` (change the blocking PDBs, then run the drain in the stated waves), `completed`, `decisions` (batch size, waves), `artifacts` (runbook, digest, producer A21), `blockers` (blocked PDB names, `human-approval`), `constraints` (window).
